absent: Memory acceptance helper behavior and hypercall identifier values and status encodings beyond retry handling.
Trust domain configuration and cache and translation flush requirement predicates and halt replacement mechanics.
Decryption marker helper and physical address conversion and page table lookup and level size helpers.
Global shared counter initialization and concurrency protection beyond atomic updates.
Firmware table lock helper implementation and paravirt dispatch table layout.
Processor capability constants and vendor identifiers and boot option encodings.
Error reporting context layout and page protection encodings and low page accounting.
Hypervisor timing calibration and virtualization call clobber details beyond memory ordering.
Alternative patching section layout and call thunk and speculation mitigation mechanics when enabled.

findings.text: Guest physical range mapping requests a hypercall for the supplied interval with privacy choice encoded in bounds handling, treats a retry status as a request to resume from an untrusted address, validates that the resume address lies inside the original interval and fails otherwise, advances the start on forward progress while resetting the stall counter, counts attempts without progress against a small fixed bound, and reports success only when the hypercall indicates no error.

Privacy conversion is split across two phases where the prepare phase handles transition toward private before mapping change and the finish phase handles transition toward shared after mapping change, conversion toward private requires memory acceptance before use, and the finish phase adjusts a global shared page count downward for privacy gain and upward for privacy loss while reporting input output error on mapping failure.

Kernel reload begin path does nothing unless reload support is enabled and otherwise attempts to halt ongoing privacy conversions with a warning on failure without waiting in crash context, while the finish path walks the direct map by page table level size, clears entries marked as decrypted to block further access, requests reconversion toward private with error logging on failure, flushes translation caches once, and compares the discovered shared count with the global counter to log accounting mismatch.

Early guest detection probes a processor identification leaf and compares the returned signature with the expected trust domain marker, forces guest and reliable clock capabilities on match, records the vendor, configures the trust domain and confidentiality mask, narrows the physical address mask to valid guest address bits, installs conversion prepare and finish hooks along with cache and translation flush requirements and reload hooks, replaces halt operations to avoid missed wakeups from emulated halt behavior, disables parallel processor bringup due to unhandleable virtualization exception during low level identification read, and logs detection with domain attributes and controls.

Mapping a shared page through a private mapping risks unrecoverable guest shutdown while the opposite mismatch yields a recoverable virtualization exception, adjacent byte access can observe even momentary mismatch so ordering preserves only a temporary shared mapping to a private page and never the reverse, and encryption state persists across reload so failure to reconvert leaves unknown state that can fault in the next kernel or during crash dump access with error logs left for diagnosis.

Resume address supplied by the hypervisor on retry is untrusted and must lie inside the original interval, with out of range values causing immediate failure rather than use, and repeated supply of the starting address without progress consumes the bounded retry allowance.

Global shared page accounting is updated only in the finish phase with decrement on transition toward private and increment on transition toward shared, and the reload finish walk expects the counter to match the number of decrypted entries discovered.
Provides a setter that records the supplied confidentiality mask into a global variable for later address handling.

Layered processor identification access includes a paravirt dispatch hook, a leaf plus subleaf helper that loads inputs then delegates, a single leaf helper returning the leading register, and a hypervisor base scanner that steps through candidate bases in the reserved range and compares signatures with builtin memory compare to stay safe for early boot before instrumentation.

Defines distinct processor identification leaves for feature discovery and timing information plus a privileged virtual machine indicator occupying the least significant position, used to detect hypervisor presence and to obtain clock frequency.

Provides hypercall wrappers for calls with no parameters and with one or two parameters that place the call identifier in a fixed register and trigger a virtualization call instruction, returning the host result while ordering memory access.

Cache flush helper issues a full writeback invalidate only when not running under a hypervisor, while global lock acquire and release delegate to architecture helpers operating on the firmware table lock field and report outcome through an output parameter.

Provides division of a combined high and low value by a word operand yielding quotient and remainder, and logical right shift by a single position across the combined pair, both implemented with inline assembly.

When firmware table support is present the disable path marks table use and bus and interrupt use as disabled, while the absent configuration provides empty stubs and zero valued indicators for local interrupt controllers and error handling, plus no operation defaults for reduced hardware initialization and root pointer access returning zero and wakeup mailbox access returning null or zero.

Helpers set flags that disable interrupt handling and bus use with empty variants when firmware support is absent, and wakeup address setup is skipped when running as a paravirtual guest as detected by a processor feature test.

C state limiter forces shallow sleep for an early processor family with old steppings or when a known wakeup erratum is present and otherwise preserves the requested limit, architecture capability reports power control support only for certain vendors based on the boot processor record, per processor data is resolved through per processor storage, and feature test folds to constant when the required mask bit is set and otherwise probes capability.

Initializes the processor capability word with multiprocessing and software coordination bits, adds extended state and fast channel and collaborative performance bits when corresponding processor features are present, clears fast channel sleep bits when monitor wait is unavailable or disabled by boot option, and when running as the initial domain of a hypervisor delegates sanitization to a helper that faults in this configuration.

Processor presence in the firmware table is determined by a nonzero local interrupt indicator, root pointer setters and getters forward to a platform operation vector with architecture capability macros advertising their presence, and the operating system mapping alias maps to itself.

Error information memory attribute always reports an unencrypted kernel mapping regardless of address due to inconsistent firmware map lifetime and encryption considerations, the architecture error reporting helper always indicates invalid argument, the table upgrade physical limit derives from mapped low pages shifted by page size, and power initialization capability is advertised as present.
Mapping helpers toggle single page caching between uncached and writeback behavior while the flush helper issues a full cache writeback invalidate.

Alternative instruction descriptor records offsets to original and replacement code and combined feature and control flags expressible as split halfwords or as a whole word plus lengths of both sequences with packed layout, while the call site range holds start and end pointers to call locations.

Flag layout reserves the upper halfword for control flags with distinct bits for negation and direct call handling plus derived combinations for negated feature test and direct call feature test and unconditional call, while the lock prefix expands to an atomic prefix in one configuration and to empty in the other.

Patching framework emits the original sequence with padding to cover a longer replacement plus separate sections describing location and length and applicability and holding replacement bytes, with helpers providing single and multiple alternative forms and ternary selection and inline assembly wrappers with memory ordering and optional inputs.

In this configuration call thunk patching for builtins and modules and destination translation and depth accounting are no operations returning identity or zero, speculation handling initialization and finalization and release are empty while the static thunk getter warns once and returns null, and rethunk predicates always report false.
Each examined header defines a unique inclusion guard macro to prevent multiple inclusion.

Kexec finish path requires disabled interrupts as enforced by an assertion, while firmware global lock accessors provide acquire and release operations on the firmware lock without additional ordering beyond helper implementation.
